effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less. Then, if you have [Arata Sanada] or [Eater Adam], your opponent's effects can't reduce this Digimon's DP or return it to hands or decks until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with the [Unidentified] trait are deleted, you may play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying the cost. (Digimon/Cost 14/Lv.6/White/Mega/Unknown/Unidentified/3000 DP)
